shadows.label: 阴影 1 - Shadow 1
shadows.description: Shadow: `rgba(0,0,0,0.4) 0 4px 12px` (dark mode has no shadow effect, so subtle)

borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: X's iOS app is a newsroom collapsed into a phone screen. The default canvas is pure black (`#000000`) — a deliberate choice that pairs OLED battery savings with the stark, reportage-style aesthetic X has cultivated since the 2023 rebrand from Twitter. Every post sits on a full-bleed black sheet divided by hairline rules in cool neutral gray (`#2F3336`), and the UI chrome is monochrome except for one surviving accent: the legacy Twitter Blue (`#1D9BF0`) used for links, mentions, the verified checkmark on legacy accounts, and the "Reply" action color. The feeling is dense, serious, and real-time — closer to a Bloomberg terminal than a social app.

borders.label: 边框 2 - Border 2
borders.description: Dim Divider (`#38444D`): Dividers on dim mode.

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: Hairline dividers (`#2F3336` dark / `#EFF3F4` light) — not rules, not cards, just 1pt separators

borders.label: 边框 4 - Border 4
borders.description: Text Secondary Light (`#536471`): @handles, timestamps on light.

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use pure black {#000000} as the default dark canvas — X is committed to true-black OLED。
建议：Reserve Twitter Blue {#1D9BF0} for links, replies, verified marks, and the active tab underline。
建议：Use role-specific colors on action icons: blue (reply/bookmark), green (repost), pink (like)。
建议：Keep post rows flat with 1pt hairlines — no shadows, no cards, no elevation between posts。
建议：Use the Chirp font at weights 400 and 700 only (with 500 for select labels) — no lights, no extra-bolds。
dont: 避免：use shadows to separate posts — hairlines are the brand-correct separator。
避免：colorize post body text — body text is always primary neutral。
避免：add more accent colors beyond blue / green / pink — they map 1:1 to reply / repost / like。
避免：use uppercase on button labels — "Post", "Follow", "Subscribe" are in sentence case。
避免：use thin font weights — Chirp starts at 400 and tops out at 700。
